description:
WE POWER PEOPLE’S PROGRESS.
At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.
We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.
Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.
MEET THE TEAM!
At Preply, we are on a mission to create world-class, localized experiences that connect learners and tutors across the globe. We work with intention, thriving on innovation, collaboration, a data-driven approach to localization operations, while balancing linguistic excellence with the speed required for global growth.
As a Localization Project Manager based in Barcelona, you’ll help bring Preply’s product and content to learners and tutors around the world. You’ll own multilingual projects from intake to launch, working directly with the teams that create those experiences. As demand for localization grows, you’ll have the autonomy to test better ways of working on live projects and help shape how the team delivers at scale.
ABOUT THE ROLE
PROJECT DELIVERY
 - Own a portfolio of multilingual localization projects across multiple workflows and drive its strategic direction. Prioritize work in line with business impact, balancing stakeholder needs, deadlines, and available capacity.

 - Own linguist allocation for your projects. Coordinate shared capacity with other localization PMs, resolving scheduling conflicts to maintain business continuity at team level.
 - Drive strategic initiatives that improve localization delivery and support the team’s OKRs. Put changes into practice and document updated workflows so other PMs can adopt them.
 - Escalate localization quality issues to the Quality workstream and communicate any impact on delivery timelines.
 - Track project spend and flag unexpected cost increases.
 - Support other localization PMs with project delivery when needed.
STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT

 - Use regular conversations to surface upcoming localization needs. Follow up on known plans and flag lead-time or capacity risks.
 - Share regular updates on project health, using delivery data to explain progress, risks, and decisions needed. Work with stakeholders to resolve issues within assigned projects and agree on actions and owners.
 - When priorities compete or plans change, recommend a way forward and escalate decisions that require broader alignment.
OPERATIONAL IMPROVEMENTS
 - Identify opportunities to improve your assigned workflows using data on turnaround time, capacity, spend, quality, and manual effort, prioritizing improvements based on impact.
 - Help shape how localization scales at Preply by leading tactical improvements and contributing to strategic initiatives in collaboration with teammates and stakeholders, with opportunities to present results and recommendations with leadership.
 - Partner with the Technical Program Manager and Engineering on tooling improvements, lead agreed pilots, and help other PMs adopt changes that work.
 - Champion the regular use of AI and automation to streamline assigned localization workflows, and verify outputs before relying on them.
WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED
 - 3+ years of localization project management experience on the buyer side, vendor side, or both, with ownership of concurrent projects across different workflows.
 - Hands-on experience localizing digital products, software interfaces, or comparable technical content such as structured help documentation.
 - Experience coordinating internal stakeholders and external linguists, balancing competing deadlines and resource needs.
 - Hands-on experience with translation management systems, CAT tools, and project management platforms.
 - Experience managing AI-supported localization workflows, such as machine translation (MT) only or MT with human post-editing.
 - Some hands-on experience using AI at work and readiness to use it regularly in localization operations.
 - Professional fluency in English.
NICE TO HAVE
 - Native or near-native proficiency in Polish.

title: Senior Product Manager - Platform
description:
Headquarters: Remote
 Senior Product Manager - Platform 
 Bitwarden empowers enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely store and share sensitive data. With a transparent, open-source approach to password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations, Bitwarden makes it easy for users to extend robust security practices across all online activities. Founded in 2016 with headquarters in Santa Barbara, California, Bitwarden is supported by a passionate global community of security experts and enthusiasts.
 As Senior Product Manager, Platform at Bitwarden, you will own the foundational capabilities that every user and admin depends on: how people create accounts and sign in, how developers and other systems reach Bitwarden programmatically, and how customer data stays protected. Your scope covers account creation, authentication (SSO, role-based access), the Bitwarden CLI, our public APIs and MCP server, integrations with the business platforms our customers already use, and the security foundations underneath them, such as key management, vulnerability response, and post-quantum readiness. You will partner with Engineering, Architecture, Security, and Design to turn these into clear, shippable outcomes, and you will work with Sales and Solutions Engineering to understand how identity and integration capabilities help win and keep enterprise customers. You will use customer feedback, usage data, and competitive benchmarking to inform roadmap decisions, thinking about the end user, the IT admin, and the developer.
 This is an all-remote team and we're looking for someone located in the U.S. with no preference for time zone. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time.
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Own the roadmap for account creation and authentication, including SSO, role-based access control, and how users and admins first set up and sign in to Bitwarden
 Own the Bitwarden CLI, public APIs, and MCP server as products, making it easy for developers, admins, and AI agents to work with Bitwarden data securely
 Define and prioritize integrations with identity providers and other business platforms our customers rely on
 Partner with Security and Architecture on platform-wide data protection, including key management, vulnerability response, and post-quantum cryptography readiness, and translate that work into clear requirements and customer-facing value
 Write clear specs and user stories, and work closely with engineering to scope, sequence, and ship features
 Analyze how competitive password and identity vendors approach authentication, developer tooling, and integrations, and identify where Bitwarden can stand out
 Define and monitor adoption metrics, such as, SSO adoption, API and CLI usage, and integration usage
 Support Sales and Solutions Engineering with product knowledge on authentication, integrations, and security architecture, including RFP and security questionnaire input
 Share progress, roadmap updates, and wins with leadership and cross-functional partners
 Use AI tools to accelerate spec writing, competitive analysis, data analysis, and rapid prototyping
 WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN 
 4+ years experience in product management
 Experience with platform, developer-facing, or identity features of B2B SaaS products
 Strong technical aptitude, with familiarity with authentication standards (SAML, OIDC, SCIM) and APIs
 Comfort working with developer tools such as CLIs, REST APIs, and SDKs
 Ability to translate complex security concepts into intuitive user and admin experiences
 Ability to have technical discussions with engineering about architecture and technology tradeoffs
 Extremely organized and able to make well-informed prioritization and trade-off decisions with engineering
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills
 A growth mindset and a desire to learn from others
 Excitement and enthusiasm for open source and for better internet security
 WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS 
 Selected candidates will be invited to schedule an introduction call and potentially progress through the following stages:
 Interview with Director, Product Management
 Interview with Chief Product Officer
 Interview with Chief Technology Officer
 Reference calls
 A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US 
 Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world's largest organizations. Become an expert. You'll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.

title: Senior Product Manager, Fulfilment
description:
About Nivoda 
 Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our marketplace connects jewellers with suppliers of diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery in 70+ countries, with more than $300M in annual transactions and a $350B industry still waiting to be modernised. We are scaling fast, and we are only getting started.
 Our Mission
 For decades, the diamond trade has been slow, opaque and inefficient: hard to find stock, hard to trust prices, hard to know when anything will arrive. Nivoda exists to change that. We give businesses of every size, in every location, the same access to inventory, the same transparent pricing and the same reliable delivery as the biggest players in the industry.
 The Fulfilment & Express Team
 The Fulfilment & Express team is where Nivoda's promise to buyers is kept. We own how an order travels from supplier to jeweller: the delivery date we promise, the hubs that hold and check stock, the carriers that move it, and the returns and quality checks that protect every purchase. We are a remote-first team of product, engineering, design and QA who work closely with Operations, Customer Support, Sales and Supplier Experience. We are low on hierarchy and high on ownership, and we like solving problems where software meets the physical world.
 About the Role
 As our Senior Product Manager for Fulfilment & Express, you will own how Nivoda orders get from supplier to jeweller: accurately promised, reliably tracked and delivered fast. You will set the strategy and roadmap for a complex, operationally heavy product area that spans diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery, with physical hubs, carriers and suppliers behind every screen. Your work decides whether a jeweller trusts Nivoda with their next order, so this is a role with real commercial impact and plenty of room to lead.
 What would YOU be doing?
 Setting the fulfilment strategy for the next 2 to 4 quarters, making trade-offs explicit, including what we are choosing not to do and why
 Owning the roadmap and the numbers: running quarterly planning, sizing opportunities and setting targets for delivery-as-promised, delivery date accuracy and delivery speed
 Making our Promised Delivery Dates trustworthy by rolling out SLA-based, dynamic delivery dates across every category and route, and shaping how they are used for delay communications and, in time, shown to buyers
 Scaling Express, our hub-based fast-delivery offer, including hub workflows (receiving, inventory and RFID put/pick, QC and dispatch), ready-to-wear jewellery, consignment flows and speed options such as same-day pickup

title: Vollzeit Senior Product Manager – 100% Remote (m/w/d)
description:
⭐ Unsere Mission: Wir machen Krankenkassen handlungsfähiger. 
 MITTIQ ist die Software-Suite der läuft.one GmbH für gesetzliche Krankenkassen. Unser Ziel ist kein geringeres, als das deutsche Gesundheitssystem von Grund auf zu verbessern. 
 Unsere Suite besteht aktuell aus vier (und bald 5) Modulen und wird laufend erweitert: 
 Mit Cortex machen Kassen ihr Fachwissen per KI abrufbar, vom Gesetz über die eigene Satzung bis zur Arbeitsanweisung. Ein KI-Agent unterstützt bei der Aktualisierung und Aufbereitung. 
 Im Versorgungskompass pflegen sie Versorgungsangebote, wie besondere Arztverträge, digitale Angebote oder Vorsorgeangebote, und spielen sie an Mitarbeiter und Versicherte aus. 
 Dazu kommt mit unserer “ Rundschreiben-Lösung ” die automatische Verarbeitung von gesetzlichen Änderungen in der Wissensbasis und der internen Kommunikation Rundschreiben und  
 “ Contracts ” für die Verwaltung von Dienstleisterverträgen. 
 Verfügbar ab Januar 2027: KI-basierte Krankenhaus-Rechnungsprüfung 
 Die Suite wird laufend basierend auf echten Herausforderungen von GKVen weiterentwickelt – 23 Krankenkassen (ein Viertel aller Kassen) arbeiten bereits mit uns. 
 Der Tech-Stack ist modern, die Weiterentwicklung richtet sich an den Herausforderungen der Kassen aus. Wir setzen auf kleine Teams mit viel individueller Verantwortung und schlanke Prozesse statt Overhead in Form von Ritualen und klassischen Projektmanager-Rollen. 
 Ownership und Verantwortung gehören bei uns für alle dazu, mit allen Freiheiten und Einschränkungen, die das mit sich bringt. 
 Unsere Reise: Wir sind ein kleines Team. Unsere Entwicklung besteht aktuell aus drei Senior Software Engineers, alle mit über 10 Jahren Erfahrung in der Anwendungsentwicklung. Mathias ist Arzt, kennt die GKV von innen und führt Vertrieb und Kundenbeziehungen. Alex verantwortet Produkt und Technik. 
 Wir sind die Case Study für das, was passiert, wenn man ein Team mit klarer Mission, Drive und Bock, sinnvolle Dinge zu schaffen, in eine langsame und regulatorisch eingeschränkte Branche setzt. Wir bringen die GKV von innen heraus nach vorne – 23 Kassen innerhalb von einem Jahr und nach wie vor mehrere Deployments täglich, sprechen dabei für sich. 
 Bisher hat Alex das Produkt geführt, vom Workshop mit der Kasse bis zur Cycle-Planung und Sparring mit dem Entwicklungsteam. In den letzten Monaten ist aus einem Modul eine Suite geworden, und mit jeder neuen Kasse kommen neue Anwendungsfälle dazu. Genau an dieser Stelle suchen wir dich: als erste dedizierte Produktperson bei MITTIQ. 
 Deine Entwicklung bei uns: Du übernimmst große Teile des Produkts schrittweise, aber zügig. In den ersten sechs Monaten arbeitest du dich in Kassen, Regulatorik, Module und Team ein und bereitest Produktentscheidungen gemeinsam mit Alex vor. Danach übernimmst du die Cycle-Planung mit dem Entwicklungsteam. Nach etwa sechs Monaten verantwortest du deinen eigenen Teil der Roadmap für die MITTIQ-Suite und sitzt auch übergreifend für die Produktrichtung am gemeinsamen Tisch. Alex bleibt dein Sparringspartner, du treibst die Weiterentwicklung aber eigenständig. 
 Du bist stets in direktem Austausch mit unseren Kunden und deren Ansprechpartnern. Ob bei Workshops, im Anwendungschat oder in wiederkehrenden (Gruppen-)Calls, du bist am Puls der Zielgruppe. 
 ⚡ Dein Impact: Du bist die Person, die versteht, welche Probleme Sachbearbeitung, Fachbereiche und Vorstände in Krankenkassen wirklich haben, und die daraus entscheidet, was MITTIQ als Nächstes kann und was bewusst nicht. Du blickst bei Kassen durch, welche Anforderungen reine Regulatorik sind und welche konkret Wert schaffen, um am Ende die Lösung zu finden, die sich nicht nur in bisherige Muster einfügt, sondern das Vorgehen in der GKV einen Schritt weiter nach vorne bringt. Als erste dedizierte Produktperson prägst du, wie bei MITTIQ Produktarbeit funktioniert. 
 🌏 Location: 100 % remote. Termine mit Kassen finden teilweise vor Ort statt, wir rechnen mit 10–20 % Reiseanteil innerhalb Deutschlands. 
 Als Senior Product Manager (m/w/d) wirst du: 
 Verstehen 
 Du führst Prozess-Workshops und Deep-Dives mit Fachbereichen unserer Kassen, etwa Leistung, Versorgungsmanagement, Kundenservice und IT, vor Ort und remote 
 Du wertest Nutzungsdaten und Rückmeldungen aus unseren Modulen selbst aus, um Probleme zu quantifizieren statt zu vermuten 
 Du baust aus Fokusgruppen, Support-Anfragen und Vertriebsfeedback ein priorisiertes Problembacklog auf 
 Entscheiden 
 Du verantwortest die Roadmap der MITTIQ-Suite und entscheidest, welche Module und Funktionen wir bauen, verbessern oder einstellen 
 Du planst Cycles gemeinsam mit dem Entwicklungsteam und schreibst Issues im Linear-Stil, die klar genug sind, dass Entwickler sie gezielt umsetzen können 
 Du definierst, woran wir den Erfolg eines Moduls messen, und prüfst nach dem Launch, ob er eingetreten ist 
 Liefern 
 Du bist ein vertrauter Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden nach extern sowie für unsere Entwicklung und befähigst sie, überragende Kundenergebnisse zu erzielen 
 Du begleitest Einführungen und Co-Entwicklungen bei unseren Kassen: Anforderungen aufnehmen, Zielbild mit der Kasse entwerfen, Umsetzung abnehmen 
 Du überträgst Erkenntnisse aus einzelnen Kassen systematisch in ein Produkt, das für alle funktioniert 
 Du behältst im Blick, was Datenschutz, Sozialdatenschutz und KI-Verordnung für eine Funktion bedeuten, bevor sie gebaut wird 
 🏅 Über dich 
 Produkterfahrung: Du hast mehrere Jahre Produktverantwortung in einem B2B-Software-Umfeld getragen, idealerweise als erste oder einzige Produktperson in einem kleinen Unternehmen, oder du bist aus einer öffentlichen Behörde zu schnelllebiger Produktentwicklung gewechselt 
 Eigene Meinung: Du hast eine Haltung dazu, was in Prozessen von Krankenkassen heute schlecht läuft, und kannst sie begründen 
 Workshops: Du kannst einen Raum mit Fachbereichsleitungen, IT und Datenschutz moderieren, die dir sagen, dass das mit der KI bei ihnen nie funktionieren
